freeze.sub-freeze-desc: If you will not be able to follow Prime and enjoy all the benefits of a subscription for a long time, you can use the freeze function.
freeze.how-works-desc: As soon as you freeze your subscription, you will immediately lose access to all Prime services, but there will be subscription days on your account that you have not used yet. You can unfreeze your subscription and return all accesses at any time in the same section. (It will be necessary to re-enter the channels and chats you are interested in)
freeze.footer: Please note that you can only freeze your subscription once a year!
